string.text: The standard 7.62x39mm military cartridge with a soft steel core, designed for the defeat of personnel. It was produced in large quantities by Soviet factories for nearly half a century, and even though it was formally replaced by the more modern 5.45x39mm cartridge in the mid-1970s, it remains widely available both in military arsenals and on the black market.

The modern 7.62x39mm 7N23 military cartridge with an armor-piercing bullet, adopted in 2002, is designed to defeat personnel wearing body armor and significantly outperforms the standard 7.62x39mm PS cartridge in this regard, without sacrificing ballistics.
